observations:
Torah #145 has only 1 bechina edge in the dataset, yielding a single 2-node component. The threshold for a new package is 3+ bechina-connected concepts forming an independent domain. That threshold is not met by the current dataset coverage.

However, a structural observation is important: the source text contains the nucleus of a SECOND package — a GOOD mirror of the evil Package 1. The good-side concepts are: 'אמירת דבר הלכה בשמו' (citing halachah in one's name = spiritual immortality), and 'אגורה באהלך עולמים' (David's prayer for eternal dwelling = living in both worlds through Torah). These two concepts share the same essential nature — 'Torah-citation as the vehicle of eternal life' — and stand as the explicit positive counterpart to Package 1's evil (machloket = spiritual death and name-erasure). They appear in the source text as the 'positive case' the teaching builds from before explaining machloket's destructive inversion of it.

Why no new package is proposed now: In the current dataset, neither 'אמירת דבר הלכה בשמו' nor 'אגורה באהלך עולמים' has a bechina edge for reference 145. The text cites David's prayer as a prooftext (using 'כמו שביקש דוד') and identifies halachah-citation with spiritual non-death by implication — but the dataset does not yet encode a 'X הוא בחינת Y' edge for these nodes in this Torah. Without at least one bechina edge anchoring them together in the dataset, they cannot form a package by the algorithmic standard.

If the dataset were enriched with bechina edges such as {אמירת דבר הלכה בשמו, חיי עולם} or {אגורה באהלך עולמים, אמירת דבר הלכה בשמו}, a second package would immediately emerge. The good/evil mirror structure is structurally present in the text; it is a dataset-coverage gap, not an absence in the teaching itself.

Conclusion: With the current 1-edge dataset for Torah #145, no new independent package domain meets the 3+ node threshold. The single package identified is Package 1 (מחלקת ומות הרוחני, evil). The good mirror package is textually present but not yet representable from bechina edges alone.
